oneLiner: A re-orientation dashboard that gets PMs back up to speed in seconds when switching between projects.
problem: Product managers juggle multiple projects a day, and every switch costs 10-20 minutes of reloading context: what was the last decision, what's blocked, and who is waiting on them. That friction burns focus, causes dropped follow-ups, and leads to decisions made without full context.
targetUser: Product managers at startups and mid-size companies who own 2-5 parallel projects or workstreams and context-switch multiple times per day.
coreFlow: PM opens the dashboard and sees cards for each active project with a freshness indicator.
PM clicks a project card to expand its re-orientation brief in the same view.
The brief shows: last decision (what, when, who), current blockers (what, why stuck, owner), and who is waiting on the PM and for what.
PM clicks any item to jump to the source (ticket, doc, message) or mark it resolved / no longer waiting.
PM pins or snoozes items to clear their queue, and returns to the grid with one project marked as 're-oriented'.

screens.name: Project Grid
screens.purpose: Home view showing all active projects as cards with status, freshness, and counts of blockers and waiting-on-you items so the PM picks where to re-orient.

screens.name: Re-orientation Brief
screens.purpose: Expanded view of a single project showing the last decision, open blockers, and who's waiting on what, with one-click access to the underlying sources.

screens.name: Waiting On You
screens.purpose: Cross-project queue of everything other people are blocked on the PM for, sorted by age and importance, so nothing falls through the cracks.

screens.name: Note & Resolve
screens.purpose: Lightweight capture and closure: add a decision note, mark a blocker cleared, or log that a waiting party has been unblocked.

screens.name: Settings & Integrations
screens.purpose: Connect sources (issue tracker, docs, chat) and tune what counts as a decision, a blocker, or a waiting-on item per project.

outOfScope: Replacing existing project management or issue tracking tools
Gantt charts, roadmapping, or sprint planning
Mobile native apps (web responsive only for v1)
